body: Ne‑Yo says people tell him he should be as big as Beyoncé or Jay‑Z — but he doesn’t want that level of fame. He explained: “I don’t wanna be a slave to my success.” Talking about Beyoncé, he said: “If she wanted to go to the movies, she couldn’t just jump up and go… it’d be pandemonium.” Meanwhile Ne‑Yo’s living life simple: “I go to Target in Atlanta and buy underwear by myself, no security.” neyo beyonce.
